name: LayerCall API
description:
Score any IP address, email, phone number, domain or device — or a whole signup in one call — and get back a 0–100 risk score plus an allow / review / block verdict.

Authenticate with an API key from https://www.layercall.com/get-key. Free tier: 1,000 lookups per month, no card required. Test-mode keys are never billed.

Every endpoint accepts an optional `strictness` parameter (`lenient`, `balanced`, `strict`) that shifts the verdict thresholds without changing the underlying signals.
